title: New York's 18th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The race for New York's 18th Congressional District pits Democratic incumbent Pat Ryan against Republican challenger Jackie Auringer. The district covers parts of Orange, Ulster, and Dutchess counties in the Hudson Valley, including the cities of Newburgh, Poughkeepsie, and Kingston. Ryan, a two-tour Iraq War veteran and former Ulster County Executive, won re-election in 2024 by a 14-point margin even as Kamala Harris carried the district by only three points, leading Cook Political Report to rate the seat as 'Likely Democratic' for 2026. Auringer, a Kingston native and small business manager, is running on a platform of affordability, accountability, and opportunity, arguing that the district needs a representative focused on lowering costs and reducing partisan gridlock.
polling_note: No independent public opinion polls were found for the 2026 general election matchup between Pat Ryan and Jackie Auringer as of June 2026.

candidates.name: Pat Ryan
candidates.summary: Pat Ryan is the incumbent U.S. Representative for New York's 18th Congressional District, first elected in a 2022 special election and re-elected in 2024. A fifth-generation Hudson Valley native, West Point graduate, and decorated Iraq War veteran, he previously served as Ulster County Executive and co-founded a technology company. Ryan has focused his congressional work on affordability, protecting reproductive rights, and national security, serving on the Armed Services and Transportation & Infrastructure Committees.

candidates.name: Jackie Auringer
candidates.summary: Jackie Auringer is the Republican nominee challenging incumbent Pat Ryan for New York's 18th Congressional District. A Kingston native, she works in her family's construction business, Urban Precast, as a project manager and managerial accountant, and holds a marketing degree from Florida Gulf Coast University's Lutgert College of Business. Her campaign focuses on affordability, government accountability, and creating economic opportunity, positioning herself as a moderate Republican seeking to bridge partisan divides.

forecast.rationale: No independent public polls exist for this 2026 general election matchup, limiting direct measurement of voter sentiment. However, the available electoral and contextual data strongly favors Democratic incumbent Pat Ryan. Ryan won re-election in 2024 by a 14-point margin even as Kamala Harris carried the district by only 3 points, demonstrating significant personal electoral strength above the party baseline. Cook Political Report rates the seat as 'Likely Democratic' for 2026. Republican challenger Jackie Auringer is a credible candidate with a moderate messaging platform, but she lacks prior elected office and faces an entrenched two-term incumbent with a proven track record in the district. The combination of strong incumbency, demonstrated crossover appeal, and expert ratings supports a Likely Democratic forecast with a clear advantage for Ryan, though the absence of polling tempers confidence from high to medium.
